item.title: Jisshu Sengupta, Karishma Tanna starrer Mom 2 goes on floors at Yamuna Expressway Film City; Boney Kapoor shares details
item.description: Producer Boney Kapoor has confirmed that Mom 2, the sequel to the 2017 film Mom, has gone on floors.
